name: react-fullstack-pipeline
description: React Full-Stack Development Pipeline — from brainstorming to backend deployment. 23 skills covering the complete React development lifecycle, with triple-path training (frontend repos 4D + website design systems + backend repos 4D), 10 agent types, 63 trained knowledge entries across 16 categories.
author: React Pipeline Team

subagent_type.name: react-component-builder
subagent_type.description: Build React UI components and pages following TDD. Creates components with styling, composes pages from components. Uses design-system knowledge, react-bits, framer-motion, shadcn/ui, animal-island-ui.

subagent_type.name: react-infrastructure-engineer
subagent_type.description: Set up React project infrastructure: routing, state management (Zustand/Jotai), TypeScript types/interfaces, theme/design tokens, Vite configuration. Handles project scaffolding and architectural setup.

subagent_type.name: react-api-integrator
subagent_type.description: Build frontend API integration layer: TanStack Query hooks, data fetching patterns, optimistic updates, API client code, form validation with react-hook-form. Connects frontend to backend APIs.

subagent_type.name: react-spec-reviewer
subagent_type.description: Verify React implementation matches spec requirements. Checks component coverage, props interfaces, behavior accuracy.

subagent_type.name: react-code-reviewer
subagent_type.description: Review React code quality: best practices, hook rules, performance, accessibility, file organization.

subagent_type.name: react-trainer
subagent_type.description: Train a GitHub React repo into the knowledge base. Clones, explores, extracts 4 knowledge dimensions: api.md + patterns.md + interaction-patterns.md + design-tokens.md. Auto-detects category. Updates registry.

subagent_type.name: react-design-learner
subagent_type.description: Analyze a live website and extract its complete design system: layout, color, typography, motion, interactions, spacing, component patterns. Fetches website, catalogs every animated element, extracts CSS custom properties, documents interaction behaviors, identifies reusable UI patterns. Outputs structured design-system.md to knowledge/websites/.

subagent_type.name: react-deployer
subagent_type.description: Execute deployment tasks: build, configure, deploy, verify. Server setup, CI/CD config, container builds.

subagent_type.name: react-backend-engineer
subagent_type.description: Build backend API endpoints, database schemas, auth flows. Writes server code, tests, API documentation.

subagent_type.name: react-backend-learner
subagent_type.description: Search for and train high-quality backend GitHub repos (500+ stars) into the knowledge base. Covers API frameworks (Hono, Fastify, NestJS, tRPC), ORMs (Prisma, Drizzle, Kysely), auth (NextAuth, Lucia, Clerk), and backend utilities (Zod, BullMQ). Extracts 4 dimensions: api.md + patterns.md + backend-patterns.md + api-patterns.md. Updates registry.
